title: Past tenses: forms and uses
intro: Read this before the questions on the past simple, past continuous and past perfect.

blocks.title: past simple
items: **Form:** regular verbs add **-ed** (worked); irregular verbs have their own form (went, saw, bought).
**Negative:** did not + base verb: She **did not go**. (not *did not went*)
**Use:** a finished action at a finished time: I visited Paris in 2019.

blocks.title: past continuous
items: **Form:** was / were + verb-ing: I **was sleeping**. They **were playing**.
**Use:** an action in progress at a past moment, or the background to another action: I **was cooking** when the phone **rang**.

blocks.title: past perfect
items: **Form:** had + past participle: She **had left** before I arrived.
**Past perfect continuous:** had been + verb-ing: He **had been working** for hours.
**Use:** the EARLIER of two past actions: When I arrived, the film **had started**.

blocks.title: spelling and irregular verbs
items: buy, **bought**; teach, **taught**; catch, **caught**; bring, **brought**; think, **thought**; come, **came**; run, **ran**; drink, **drank**.
After did or did not, the verb is the base form: Did she **go**? (not *went*).

blocks.body: While and when: the longer action uses the past continuous, the shorter action that interrupts it uses the past simple.
